technical-summary: Fix v26 helper mailbox completion ticket lookup: publish the ticket offset from shared segment scratch geometry into the device launch state, and use that offset in all add/inject/shadow completion kernels instead of recomputing it from the dispatch row cap. Add a focused host contract test with a 4096-row shared allocation and 64-row dispatch cap.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed a helper-on scoring fault caused by completion kernels deriving ticket storage from a smaller row dispatch cap than the shared mailbox allocation. The exact-source card-free contract test passes; matched runtime scoring remains to be run.
